primary_crops: Cotton, Soybean, Pigeon Pea, Chickpea, Sorghum
deficiency_correction_plan: Apply 25 kg/ha Zinc Sulfate heptahydrate every 2 years; add 5 tons farmyard manure to buffer pH
Split nitrogen into 3 doses (basal, tillering, panicle initiation); incorporate crop residues
Apply lime or dolomite (1-2 t/ha) if pH < 6.0; supplement with Borax (10 kg/ha) and gypsum (200 kg/ha) for pod filling
Maintain drainage channels to avoid anaerobic compaction; apply bio-fertilizers Azospirillum and PSB

primary_crops: Cashew, Tea, Coffee, Rubber, Pineapple, Rice
deficiency_correction_plan: Agricultural lime application @ 2.5 t/ha based on buffer pH; use Rock Phosphate instead of SSP to overcome high P fixation
Incorporate elemental sulfur (200 kg/ha) or gypsum; foliar sprays of Chelated Fe-EDTA (1g/L) and Zn-EDTA (1g/L)
Provide sub-surface tile drainage to leach soluble salts; apply farmyard manure (10 t/ha) and green manure (Sesbania)
Drip fertigation with 19:19:19 water soluble fertilizer supplemented with Calcium Nitrate and Boron during fruit set
